    The colimit extension of a functor on D_fin #

    For a functor Φ : D_fin → Mod A and T ∈ D, the manuscript defines (1.1) F(T) = colim_{U ⊆ T, dim U < ∞} Φ(U). This file builds this functor Extension.functor Φ : D ⥤ Mod A, indexing the colimit by the directed poset Kron.FinSub T of finite-dimensional subrepresentations.
